title: Redesign the ML pipeline as a standing assembly line that starts from the REAL-MONEY roster backward: for every real-money/prop leg, a dataset from its own Stage-0 corpus (cost-net labels from the exit actually traded) -> CPCV -> registered non-inferiority + risk gate -> shadow -> reduce-only canary -> CUSUM demotion, retrained on a schedule; replace research intake that optimises existing heads
note: Origin: operator 2026-10-29 ~07:00Z system-first rule (header priorities.system_first). Diagnosis (manager, measured 06:40Z): the ML programme picked targets from existing models, so its lead candidate's training book covered 0 of 7 real-money legs; 43 of 50 ML units last week were learner variants of existing heads; practice principles M1-M10 were written but not built to. ML-REAL-MONEY-OVERLAY (in flight) is the first instance; this row turns it into the standing pipeline (every real-money leg, every retrain) and fixes the intake (research-ops/authoring may not queue ML units that do not map to a real-money or demo-floor decision a consumer acts on). Deliverables: the pipeline design doc (stations, owners, cadence, gates), the intake rule in research-ops/frontier skills, and the guard that refuses an ML unit with no consumer. Assembly line per practice R2.
